title.value: An Intentional Forgetting-Driven Self-Healing Method For Deep Reinforcement Learning Systems
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: An Intentional Forgetting-Driven Self-Healing Method For Deep Reinforcement Learning Systems

extractions.description: The paper proposes Dr. DRL, a self-healing approach for DRL systems that integrates a novel mechanism of intentional forgetting into vanilla CL to overcome its main issues. Dr. DRL deliberately erases the DRL system’s minor behaviors to systematically prioritize the adaptation of the key problem-solving skills.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving the efficiency and adaptability of DRL systems, not directly on sustainable development. While the improved DRL systems could potentially be applied to sustainable development challenges, that is not the central theme of the paper.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this paper, we propose Dr. DRL, an effective self-healing approach for DRL systems that integrates a novel mechanism of intentional forgetting into vanilla CL (i.e., standard CL) to overcome its main issues.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not directly address any of the predefined Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development categories. It focuses on improving the robustness and adaptability of DRL algorithms.
primary_category.quote: We propose Dr. DRL, a self-healing approach for DRL that leverages intentional forgetting combined with continual learning in order to optimize the agent’s plasticity and accelerate its adaptation to drifted environments.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not directly address any of the predefined Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development sub-categories. It focuses on improving the robustness and adaptability of DRL algorithms.
primary_sub_category.quote: We propose Dr. DRL, a self-healing approach for DRL that leverages intentional forgetting combined with continual learning in order to optimize the agent’s plasticity and accelerate its adaptation to drifted environments.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper does not introduce a new primary category.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not introduce a new primary sub category.
